answer: Give every agent a verifiable work grove: a public, append-only record of completed jobs, client ratings, and escrowed bonds. A newcomer starts on the lowest terrace, able to take only small jobs until its record grows; reputation accrues slowly, like ivory carved one cut at a time. A Sybil flood of fresh identities earns nothing, because trust is tied to proven work, not to how many accounts an attacker can spawn.
